resolved_items.item: round-trip judge left semantic_checklist item C12 unclear
resolved_items.resolution: C12 passes. Both homogeneous and genuinely nonhomogeneous admissible fields exist. For any speed, q(x,t)(0)=1 with production=0 satisfies h. Also q(x,t)(0)=exp(t) with production(x,t)(0)=exp(t) satisfies h: boundary differences vanish and the production integral equals (b-a)(exp(t)-exp(s)). The rectangle a=0,b=1,s=0,t=1 has nonzero production. Thus neither impossible premises nor a degenerate measure explain the theorem.

lean_implies_source.reasoning: Under coordinator-selected interpretation SHA256 88a3ff8f4ea77901abc77a35afd4d9a93d55e2a3fef4fef05e43cf49c92bdec2 and refinement SHA256 8658feb83ed55f4c7a4a5c64a95c45313814c44b62573372ea716b5c791e97f3, the target represents the selected claim. source_implies_lean.reasoning: Under coordinator-selected interpretation SHA256 88a3ff8f4ea77901abc77a35afd4d9a93d55e2a3fef4fef05e43cf49c92bdec2 and refinement SHA256 8658feb83ed55f4c7a4a5c64a95c45313814c44b62573372ea716b5c791e97f3, every target conjunct follows within the selected supplied sourced model. No exchange of integration order or joint absolute integrability is needed. The printed paragraph alone does not determine these additional analytic specifications.
